notes.title: RELEASE delayed to 31.06.2021!!
notes.notes:
Hi gamers,

I'm so sorry but due unexpected technical issues and lack of time I have to change release date of game "Galaxy Guardian Royale"

Its sad but due to actual world eventsm, I've been forced to change my profesional career and it took a lot of time, to be honest Im not able to solve all technical issues in current project state. I'd love to reach maximal quality of game and lot of fun for all space enthusiasts. Release date has been set to 31st March 2021 09:00 CET.


Your Game Developer,
Bl0ckDave

notes.title: Galaxy Guardian Royale - Official Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Hi folks,
 I'd like to share with you official release date for Galaxy Guardian Royale.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930982/bc2f3c6affb911063797ca1a040ef65462871482.png

 After few months of developing I realized that, GGR, begining be ready for public release. But I want to be sure, that there are no minor bugs, that game is playable and so on. So I decided to schedule release to Mar 26, 2021 - 8:00pm PDT, stay tuned! ːsteamhappyː

Bl0ckDave
